title.value: Feeding What You Need by Understanding What You Learned
title.justification: The title accurately represents the core concept of the paper, which focuses on optimizing the training process based on understanding the model's capabilities and the data's properties.
title.quote: In this paper, we focus on competency assessments for machine reading comprehension (MRC)....

extractions.description: The paper presents a framework for machine reading comprehension (MRC) that assesses model capabilities in a multi-dimensional, explainable manner. This approach seeks to optimize training by understanding both model capacity and data properties, and incorporates a Capability Boundary Breakthrough Curriculum (CBBC) strategy to improve learning efficiency.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on improving machine learning model training efficiency, particularly in machine reading comprehension, without direct linkage to eco-responsible AI applications.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we focus on competency assessments for machine reading comprehension (MRC).

secondary_categories.justification: There are no direct or indirect mentions of eco-responsible AI applications, climate, or sustainability topics.
secondary_categories.quote: The performance is usually evaluated by metrics such as Exact Match (EM ) and F 1 score, lacking interpretability to the capabilities of a model.

primary_sub_category.justification: The study does not specifically address any of the listed sub-categories related to eco-responsible AI.
primary_sub_category.quote: We argue that the value of each data sample varies during the training process of a model, depending on the model’s current capabilities.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Given the focus on machine learning methodology without eco-responsible implications, none of the sub-categories apply.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The experiments performed on four benchmark datasets verified that our approach can significantly improve the performance of existing MRC models.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily concerned with optimizing machine learning model training efficiency and interpretability, which does not fit under existing eco-responsible AI categories.
new_primary_category.quote: The experiments performed on four benchmark datasets verified that our approach can significantly improve the performance of existing MRC models.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The framework aims to improve machine learning training efficiency through understanding model capabilities, which suggests a focus on training processes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Based on the analysis of model capabilities and data properties, we feed the model with training samples that are neither too simple nor too hard for it to solve.
